# Welcome to my website

I'm a graduate student in the **M.S. in Statistics (Data Science)** program at Baruch College's Zicklin School of Business, graduating in December 2026. This site showcases my work from STA 9750 – Software Tools for Data Analysis, where I used R to acquire, clean, analyze, and visualize real-world data.

Before graduate school, I worked as an **Underwriter at Fora Financial**, where I focused on financial analysis and risk assessment. I also hold a **Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science** from Baruch College.

**Interests:** Statistical Modeling, Risk Analysis, Predictive Modeling, Data Visualization

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, zoom = 17) |>
  addPopups(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude,
            "Here is <b>Baruch College</b>!")
